answer: Agents bond stake, commit to a polynomial identity, and evaluate it each epoch to derive rate-limit nullifiers. A Semaphore-style proof hides the secret while proving membership; duplicate messages reusing an epoch nullifier yield distinct Shamir shares that reconstruct the signing key, triggering immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Whether named ember, plume, or falcon, each identity must bond stake, so multiplying accounts carries a cost and repeated use is attributable.
